text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraph-by-paragraph organization","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in distinct sections that each develop a separate point more coherently."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"First thing I will like to accomplish in life\"","quality":"focus","description":"The essay stays centered on one controlling purpose and returns to it across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"more controlled sentence boundaries","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay has fewer run-on strings and more sentences that are easier to follow."},{"evidence":"more standard academic phrasing","quality":"register","description":"The essay uses a more school-appropriate, reflective tone with fewer awkward informal turns of phrase."},{"evidence":"some attempted transitions such as \"Therefore\" and \"Last thing I have to say\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay links ideas with clearer signposting and smoother movement from one point to the next."},{"evidence":"broader vocabulary like \"accomplish,\" \"vocabulary,\" and \"aspect\"","quality":"lexical range","description":"The essay shows a wider range of word choice and more varied expression."},{"evidence":"fewer severely unclear or mistranslated phrases","quality":"clarity","description":"The essay's meaning is generally easier to understand despite errors."}]}
